steps.what: List the published casting call for the role.
Record which roles the actor attended.

tasks.design: A casting call already published, with a time and a place, is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor attends the audition. A call with no time is not listed. The list does not rank who is seen and it does not audition.
tasks.previous_blocker: Call times were copied from a message thread on the morning of the audition.
tasks.enabler_now: A published call with a time and a place can be listed before the actor leaves.
tasks.still_hard: The room, the reader, and the choice of who is seen, which the list does not make.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can read a complete call and still have to do the audition.
tasks.altitude: A published call can be listed. The actor still attends. Nobody is ranked or filtered by the list.

reach.task: Post the call with a time and a place, and leave the audition with the actor.
reach.learn: The call can be listed. The audition stays here.

evidence.claim: A casting call already published, with a time and a place, can be listed. The list cannot attend the audition.
Filtering or ranking who should be auditioned, including a self-employed performer, is a hiring decision and is not done here. The actor attends.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Call id, time, and place, produced by the published call. A call with no time is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the call list the company already publishes. Do not score or rank a performer.
unknowns: Which auditions the actor must attend in person.
research_questions: What share of auditions have a published time and place?
Which calls are still a private message?

already_counted.description: The actor still attends the audition.
The actor still records which role was read.

incremental.description: The actor confirms a call the list did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a casting call that is already published with a time and a place. It disappears when the time is missing and the actor confirms it. Attending the audition stays with the actor. No one is ranked.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Find the interpretation with the director.

steps.what: List the rehearsal already called with the director.
Work closely with directors, other actors, and playwrights.
Record the interpretation most suited to the role.

tasks.design: A rehearsal already called with the director is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor works with the director, the other actors, and the playwright to find the interpretation. A rehearsal with no call id is not listed. The list does not interpret the role.
tasks.previous_blocker: The call to rehearse was a message the night before, and the scene was not named.
tasks.enabler_now: A rehearsal already called can be listed before the actor arrives.
tasks.still_hard: The interpretation, which is found in the room and not on the call.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can hear that the reading suited to the role is not the one just tried.
tasks.altitude: A called rehearsal can be listed. The actor still works with the director and the playwright, and still finds the interpretation.

reach.task: Be in the room when the interpretation is found. A call does not settle it.
reach.learn: The rehearsal time can be listed. The interpretation stays here.

evidence.claim: A rehearsal already called can be listed. The list cannot find an interpretation or work with a director.
The actor, the director, and the playwright find the reading. A schedule does not choose it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Rehearsal id, produced by the call already made. A rehearsal with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the rehearsal book the company already keeps.
unknowns: Which readings are settled only with the playwright present.
research_questions: What share of rehearsals are already on the call?
Which interpretations change in the room?

already_counted.description: The actor still works with the director and the others.
The actor still records the interpretation.

incremental.description: The actor confirms a rehearsal the book did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a rehearsal already called. It disappears when the call is missing and the actor confirms it. Finding the interpretation with the director, the other actors, and the playwright stays in the room.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the scene already called for this performance.
Portray and interpret the role using speech, gestures, and movements.
Entertain, inform, or instruct radio, television, or live audiences.

tasks.design: A scene already called for the performance is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor portrays and interprets the role, with speech, gestures, and movement, for a radio, television, film, or live audience. A scene with no call id is not listed. The list does not portray the role.
tasks.previous_blocker: The scene number was confirmed in a corridor just before the actor walked on.
tasks.enabler_now: A scene already called can be listed before the performance.
tasks.still_hard: The portrayal itself, which no list can do.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can play the scene in a way the call sheet cannot specify.
tasks.altitude: A called scene can be listed. The actor still portrays the role for the audience.

reach.task: Have the called scene ready, and leave the portrayal with the actor.
reach.learn: The scene call can be listed. The performance stays here.

evidence.claim: A scene already called can be listed. The list cannot portray a role or speak to an audience.
The performance is the actor's. A call sheet is not a portrayal and it is not a substitute performer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Scene id, produced by the call already made. A scene with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the call the company already publishes. The actor performs.
unknowns: Which performances are live and which are recorded.
research_questions: What share of performances start from a called scene?
Which scenes are changed at the last moment?

already_counted.description: The actor still portrays the role.
The actor still plays to the audience.

incremental.description: The actor confirms a scene the call did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a scene already called for the performance. It disappears when the scene is missing and the actor confirms it. Portraying and interpreting the role stays with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List scenes and the call already broken out of the script.
Study and rehearse roles from scripts to learn and memorize lines.
Rehearse stunts and cues as directed, and interpret them.

tasks.design: Scenes already broken out of the script, and the call that names them, are listed from {DOCS}. The actor studies and rehearses the role, learns and memorizes the lines, and rehearses stunts and cues as directed. A scene with no id is not listed. The list does not memorize a line.
tasks.previous_blocker: The actor hunted the next scene in a full script on the morning of rehearsal.
tasks.enabler_now: A scene already marked, and the call that names it, can be listed before rehearsal.
tasks.still_hard: Learning the line and the stunt, which the actor still does.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can have every scene listed and still not know the line.
tasks.altitude: Marked scenes and the call can be listed. The actor still studies, rehearses, and memorizes.

reach.task: Rehearse from a part already marked, and still learn it yourself.
reach.learn: The scene list can be shared. The memorizing stays here.

evidence.claim: A production tool can break a script the company already holds into scenes and can prepare the call sheet. It does not rehearse the role or memorize the lines.
The actor studies, rehearses, and memorizes. The breakdown uses the script the production already holds. It is not a new performance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.

Fields: Scene id, produced by a breakdown of the script the production already holds. A scene with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the script the company is already allowed to rehearse. The actor memorizes the lines.
unknowns: Which scripts are already broken into scenes.
Which stunts are rehearsed only with a director present.
research_questions: What share of rehearsals start from a marked scene?
Which lines are learned with no scene list?

already_counted.description: The actor still studies and memorizes the lines.
The actor still rehearses stunts and cues.

incremental.description: The actor marks a scene the breakdown did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing scenes already broken out of the script and the call that names them. It disappears when the scene is unmarked and the actor finds it. Studying, rehearsing, and memorizing stay with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The actor still attends the audition, still finds the interpretation with the director, and still portrays and rehearses the role. A published call can be listed. It does not rank who is seen and it does not memorize a line.
reach: Art directors post a call with a time and a place, and this job learns the call is not the audition.
Musicians and singers rehearse from a score a person has already marked, and this job learns a scene list is not the rehearsal.
skills_to_grow: Attend the audition. Do not let a list decide who is seen.
Rehearse and memorize the lines. A scene list does not do that.
role.ambitious_version: Published calls and marked scenes are listed first. Audition, interpretation, portrayal, and rehearsal stay with the actor.
